description: This file defines the ExportTagsCommand class responsible for exporting tags from dashboards and charts in the Superset project, including merging tags and generating YAML content.

classes.name: ExportTagsCommand
classes.description: Class responsible for exporting tags, merging dashboard and chart tags, and generating YAML content for export.

methods.name: _file_name
methods.description: Returns the filename 'tags.yaml' for the exported tags.

methods.name: _merge_tags
methods.description: Merges dashboard and chart tags into a unique list based on tag name.

methods.name: _file_content
methods.description: Generates YAML content of tags filtered from dashboards and charts based on provided IDs.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Generator method that yields filename and content lambda if the tagging system feature is enabled.
